Name: DustyNPC
Author: Endwyr
Description:
Essentially follows Alex around to most locations, but some evenings goes off exploring on his own.

== FAQ ==
Does Dusty care if I dig in the trash?
He's curious, but he doesn't care (no friendship points lost).

== Likes/Dislikes ==
Loves
Meat, Cooking, Chewing Stick, Bone Flute, Bone Fragment, Driftwood

Likes
Monster Loot, Both Lucky Purple Shorts, Soggy Newspaper, Wood, Hardwood, Prehistoric Bones & Nautilus/Amphibian Fossils, Fossilized Skull/Spine/Tail/Leg/Ribs, Snake Skull/Vertibrae

Dislikes & Hates
Seeds, Greens, Grapes, Bone Fragments, Radioactive Things, Any Cakes, Pies, Cookies, Sweets, anything that is toxic to dogs, and anything with Sugar

== Compatibility ==
Is it compatible with DustyMod2ElectricBoogaloo?
I have not tested mod compatibility, but feel free to comment if you find out.
Any mods that edit Dusty's pen are likely incompatible (see the image of Dusty's pen for specific tiles).

== 1.6 ==
YUP! I really struggled with this (but I 100% understand it now), and it's up! 1.6 is super powerful for NPC control, so lemme know if he's doing anything that dog's shouldn't do and I'll make him better! :D
Shouldn't be buggy, but there might be some minor stuff that needs tweaked, let me know!!!!
